title: Lead event, major version 1
description: One inbound interaction (a call, SMS or, from 1.1, an email) exactly as received from the provider, published to the LEADS stream on leads.raw.<channel>. Minor versions only add: consumers must ignore fields they don't know, and must dead-letter a schema_version or channel they don't support rather than guess. Examples for every minor version are in examples/.

schema_version.description: Major version of this schema. A breaking change publishes a new major version alongside this one.

channel.description: How the lead contacted us; also the last token of the subject. email was added in 1.1: a consumer that does not support it must dead-letter it.

provider_id.description: The provider's unique ID for the interaction: Twilio's CallSid or MessageSid, or an email's Message-ID header. Also the message's Nats-Msg-Id, so provider retries are deduplicated.

from.description: The caller or sender as the provider sent it. For calls and SMS usually E.164, but may be empty or a word such as Anonymous when caller ID is withheld; for email, the sender's address.

to.description: The tracking number (or, for email, tracking address) contacted, which identifies the campaign.

received_at.description: When the edge received the webhook, RFC 3339 in UTC.

params.description: Every original form parameter, kept so events can be replayed and reprocessed. Values are lists because a form parameter may repeat.

attachment_count.description: Email only (1.1): how many attachments the email had. Their content is not kept.
